So if I wear shorts, I need a drawstring that I can cinch tight like a corset, dig into the fat, and hold up a phone, wallet, and keys.  Unless you have excellent grip strength in nimble fingers, like tying knots with the shorts around your knees then pulling up while tucking fat rolls into, or don't care about the drawstring, the drawstring NEEDS to be at least two inches longer, four if I'm being honest.

Because the drawstring is so short, and I don't want to risk fishing them out of the waistband, I haven't undone the knot when sitting, and I have left feeling uncomfortable in these shorts way more than I should.
